thread.title: Dow Jones, Stock Market Sell Off To Start The New Year | Investor's Business Daily

author: SCOTT LEHTONEN
title: Dow Jones, Stock Market Sell Off To Start The New Year | Investor's Business Daily
text:
The major stock indexes kicked off the new year with heavy losses in today's stock market . The Dow Jones industrials lost about 200 points after disappointing economic data out of China. Among stock leaders, Apple ( AAPL ) declined 1.5%, FANG stock Netflix ( NFLX ) slid 3% on bearish analyst commentary, while Tesla ( TSLA ) hit the brakes after its own disappointing data .
X The tech-heavy Nasdaq composite fell nearly 2% at the stock market open before trimming losses to 0.7% in morning trade. Meanwhile, the Dow Jones industrials and S&P 500 indexes declined 0.7% and 0.6% respectively. ( For updates on this story and other market coverage, visit the Stock Market Today page.)
Stock Market Rally Fizzles The major stock indexes scored a four-day win streak to end 2018. But downside volatility returned to the stock market in earnest Wednesday. Despite the pervasive weakness, the stock market remains within a rally attempt, since it hasn't undercut the lows set on Dec. 24 and 26.
Despite Wednesday's sell-off, investors should still be on the lookout for a follow-through day , which could happen at any time. The follow-through day gives investors the green light to begin buying stocks that are breaking out past proper buy points. But don't be too aggressive , not all follow-through days are successful.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Apple Stock Leads Dow Jones Lower Among the Dow Jones stocks , Apple stock was one of the biggest decliners Wednesday with a 1.5% fall. The iPhonemaker is about 34% off its 52-week high and is having trouble sustaining any upside momentum.
FANG stock Netflix fell over 3% after analyst firm SunTrust Robinson Humphrey reduced its price target from 410 to 355. Analyst Matthew Thornton forecast that the video streaming giant will report that it added fewer-than-expected subscribers last quarter. Netflix stock is about 40% off its 52-week high.
Tesla Stock Slams On The Brakes Tesla stock screeched to a halt Monday with an 8% loss after the company announced weaker-than-expected Q4 deliveries and a price cut. Tesla delivered 90,700 vehicles during the fourth quarter, missing Wall Street's estimates. Meanwhile, the company reduced prices on all of its models by $2,000 to help offset the end of the $7,500 federal tax credit.
Tesla stock is back below its 200-day moving average line and near its recent low prices. A breakout above a cup with handle's 366.85 buy point showed initial promise, but the stock market's weakness eventually caught up with the high-flying stock. Tesla stock triggered the 7%-8% loss-cutting sell signal on Dec. 18.
IBD 50 Stocks To Watch: Software Stocks Crumble Among the leading growth stocks , top software names were among the day's weaker performers at the stock market open. Atlassian ( TEAM ), ServiceNow ( NOW ) and Veeva Systems ( VEEV ) all fell at least 1%.
Atlassian broke out above a 89.92 cup-with-handle entry Monday, but is now about 4% below the buy point after Wednesday's 2% drop. The stock was featured in the Stocks Near A Buy Zone column Monday.
ServiceNow is trying to find support at its 50-day line amid a more than three-month consolidation. Shares fell 1.5%.
Veeva is still about 20% off its 52-week high, as it searches for support near its long-term 200-day moving average line. The stock fell over 2%.
